tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Access Weekly Commissioner Desk Interface
stories.goal: access the unified weekly content creation hub from the league navigation menu
stories.benefit: I can manage all my weekly content creation tasks in one centralized location
acceptanceCriteria: Commissioner Desk menu item appears in left-side navigation for users with Commissioner or Admin role
Desk interface loads with current season and most recent week pre-selected by default
System displays three content creation sections: Power Rankings, Matchup of the Week, and Predictions
Any existing draft content for the selected week is automatically loaded and displayed
System restricts access to Commissioner Desk for Manager and Fan roles with appropriate error message

stories.title: Navigate Between Seasons and Weeks
stories.goal: select different seasons and weeks to create or edit content for any time period
stories.benefit: I can manage content for past, current, and future weeks without losing my work
acceptanceCriteria: Season selector dropdown displays all seasons associated with the league (dynasty continuity or redraft mapping)
Week selector displays weeks 1-N based on league schedule length, plus playoff weeks
System preserves any unsaved draft content when switching between weeks with confirmation prompt
Selected season/week context persists across browser sessions via local storage
Visual indicator shows which weeks have published content vs drafts vs no content
System defaults to current week for current season, or most recent week for past seasons

stories.title: Create New Content Draft
stories.goal: start creating new weekly content from a blank state or previous week's template
stories.benefit: I can begin my weekly content creation process efficiently with helpful starting points
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Create New Draft' button for weeks with no existing draft or published content
User can optionally copy previous week's structure (power rankings order, matchup predictions format) as starting template
New draft is created in database with status 'draft' and timestamp
All three content sections (rankings, matchup, predictions) initialize in empty/unpublished state
System displays clear indication that content is in draft mode with 'Last saved' timestamp

stories.title: Autosave Draft Content Continuously
stories.goal: have my work automatically saved as I create content without manual save actions
stories.benefit: I don't lose any work if my browser crashes or I navigate away accidentally
acceptanceCriteria: System autosaves all draft changes every 30 seconds while user is actively editing
Autosave triggers immediately after user stops typing for 3 seconds (debounced save)
Visual indicator shows 'Saving...' during save operation and 'All changes saved' with timestamp after completion
System handles offline scenarios by queueing changes and syncing when connection restored
Autosave preserves incomplete content (e.g., partially filled rankings, empty commentary fields)
System displays error notification if autosave fails and allows manual retry

stories.title: Edit Existing Draft Content
stories.goal: modify and refine draft content across multiple editing sessions before publishing
stories.benefit: I can work on my weekly content over several days without losing progress
acceptanceCriteria: System loads most recent saved draft when Commissioner accesses a week with existing draft
All content sections display saved draft data with edit controls enabled
User can switch between content sections (rankings, matchup, predictions) without losing changes
System tracks draft version history with 'Last modified' timestamp and modifier user
Draft remains in 'draft' status until explicitly published by user

stories.title: Preview Draft Content Before Publishing
stories.goal: see exactly how my content will appear to league members before making it public
stories.benefit: I can catch errors and verify formatting before publishing to avoid embarrassment
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Preview' button that renders content in read-only view matching public display
Preview shows how power rankings, matchup of the week, and predictions will appear on respective pages
Preview displays how feed moments will appear in the newsfeed timeline
User can return to edit mode from preview without losing unsaved changes
Preview mode is clearly indicated with visual banner stating 'Preview Mode - Not Published'

stories.title: Publish Weekly Content to Feed and Pages
stories.goal: publish completed weekly content with a single action that updates all relevant pages and creates feed moments
stories.benefit: I can share my content with the league efficiently without manual multi-step processes
acceptanceCriteria: System provides prominent 'Publish' button that is disabled until all required content sections are complete
Publish action validates all content sections and displays specific error messages for incomplete or invalid data
Single publish operation updates power rankings page, matchup page, predictions data, and creates feed moments atomically
System creates separate feed moment for each content type published (rankings moment, matchup moment, predictions moment)
Published content status changes from 'draft' to 'published' with publication timestamp and publisher user ID
System displays success confirmation with links to view published content and feed moments
User cannot edit published content directly; system creates new draft version for edits with 'Updated' indicator

stories.title: Skip Optional Content Sections
stories.goal: choose not to create certain weekly content types without being blocked from publishing others
stories.benefit: I have flexibility to publish only the content I want for a given week
acceptanceCriteria: Each content section (Power Rankings, Matchup of the Week, Predictions) has explicit 'Skip This Week' toggle
Skipped sections are excluded from validation requirements for publishing
System clearly indicates skipped sections with visual styling and explanatory text
Publish action creates feed moments only for non-skipped content sections
User can un-skip a section later and add content without affecting already-published sections
System tracks skip status in database with week association for historical reference

stories.title: Manage Draft State Across Multiple Weeks
stories.goal: see which weeks have drafts, published content, or no content at a glance
stories.benefit: I can stay organized and know which weeks need my attention
acceptanceCriteria: Week selector displays status badges for each week: 'Published', 'Draft', or 'Empty'
Published weeks show green checkmark icon with publication date on hover
Draft weeks show orange clock icon with 'Last edited' timestamp on hover
Empty weeks show gray icon indicating no content created yet
System provides quick navigation to 'Next unpublished week' for efficient workflow
Week list scrolls to current week on initial load for temporal context

stories.title: Update Previously Published Content
stories.goal: correct errors or add updates to already-published weekly content
stories.benefit: I can fix mistakes or add new information without losing the original publication
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Edit Published Content' button for weeks with published content
Editing published content creates new draft version while preserving original publication
Draft edits are not visible to league members until republished
Republishing displays 'Updated' badge on feed moments and pages with update timestamp
System maintains version history showing original publication and all subsequent updates
Feed moment bumping occurs only if republished content has significant changes (configurable threshold)
